mapper.select:
select
from corgi_vlog v left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = v.user_id where v.ctime <=#{ctime} and v.user_id != #{userId}
and d.group in (select `group` from user_prefer_group where user_id = #{userId})
order by like_count desc limit 20

`like_count` = like_count + ${vlog.likeCount},
`view_count` = view_count + ${vlog.viewCount},
`comment_count` = comment_count + ${vlog.commentCount},
where activity_id = #{vlog.activityId}
